scopeNotes: Gameplay and GPU fixture runs preceded a debugger-only layout/report-field edit. Renderer, controls and decoder were unchanged; final unit/build/reconstruction checks include that edit.
The decoder receives final pixels and calibration only; intended depth is introduced in a separate comparison step.
Alternate matches include inherent harmonics and are not proof of human ghost perception.
Scene hues remain shared by stereo equivalence classes; arbitrary original artwork cannot be reproduced exactly.
